senses.en: The name given to you first, before your family name.

ex.en: My first name is Gina.
ex.zh: 我的名字叫吉娜。

ex.en: What's your first name?
ex.zh: 你的名字是什么？

tip: 英语姓名顺序是「名在前、姓在后」，和中文相反。

senses.en: Final in a sequence, or most recent before the present.
To continue for a period or remain usable.
After everyone else, or on the most recent previous occasion.

ex.en: I caught the last bus home just before midnight.
ex.zh: 我在午夜前刚好赶上了回家的末班车。

ex.en: Products that last longer can reduce household spending and limit the amount of waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 更耐用的产品可以减少家庭开支，并减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物量。

tip: last week指上周；the last week可指最后一周。

senses.en: Your family name, the last part of your full name.

ex.en: Her last name is Miller.
ex.zh: 她姓米勒。

ex.en: What is your last name?
ex.zh: 你姓什么？

senses.en: someone you know well, like, and enjoy spending time with

ex.en: I met an old friend at the market yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天在市场遇到了一位老朋友。

ex.en: Maintaining close friendships can improve mental wellbeing, as friends often provide emotional support during difficult periods.
ex.zh: 维持亲密友谊可以改善心理健康，因为朋友常在困难时期提供情感支持。

col: keep in touch with friends｜与朋友保持联系
tip: “与某人交朋友”用make friends with，friends用复数。

senses.en: a country in East Asia

ex.en: My cousin returned from China with beautiful mountain photographs.
ex.zh: 我的表亲从中国回来，带回了漂亮的山景照片。

ex.en: The expansion of high-speed rail in China illustrates how transport investment can improve connections between major cities.
ex.zh: 中国高铁网络的扩展说明了交通投资如何改善主要城市之间的联系。

tip: China指中国；小写china指瓷器，形容词用Chinese。

senses.en: The central part, point, or position of something
Located between other things or between the beginning and end

ex.en: Someone left a suitcase in the middle of the hallway.
ex.zh: 有人把一个行李箱放在了走廊正中央。

ex.en: Housing costs often force essential workers to live far from the middle of the cities they serve.
ex.zh: 住房成本常常迫使提供必要服务的工作者住在远离其服务城市中心的地方。

tip: 名词常用the middle of；形容词直接修饰名词。

senses.en: A place where children learn, or the time spent learning there.
A group sharing particular ideas, methods, or styles.
A group of fish swimming together.

ex.en: We walk to school together along the river.
ex.zh: 我们一起沿着河边步行上学。

ex.en: Every school should provide opportunities for students to develop practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
ex.zh: 每所学校都应提供机会，让学生在学习学科知识的同时培养实践技能。

tip: go to school指上学；go to the school指去校址。

senses.en: A school for students aged about 12 to 15.

ex.en: I study in a middle school in Beijing.
ex.zh: 我在北京一所中学读书。

ex.en: He is a middle school student.
ex.zh: 他是一名中学生。

senses.en: A girl's name.

ex.en: This is my friend Gina.
ex.zh: 这是我的朋友吉娜。

ex.en: Gina is in Class Three.
ex.zh: 吉娜在三班。

senses.en: A girl's name, short for Jennifer.

ex.en: Jenny is my cousin.
ex.zh: 詹妮是我的表姐。

ex.en: Jenny, is this your ruler?
ex.zh: 詹妮，这是你的尺子吗？

senses.en: A boy's name.

ex.en: Alan is a new student.
ex.zh: 艾伦是一名新学生。

ex.en: Alan likes playing football.
ex.zh: 艾伦喜欢踢足球。

senses.en: A boy's name, short for Thomas.

ex.en: Tom is thirteen years old.
ex.zh: 汤姆十三岁了。

ex.en: Tom and Jack are friends.
ex.zh: 汤姆和杰克是朋友。

senses.en: A boy's name, short for Michael.

ex.en: Mike has a new bike.
ex.zh: 迈克有一辆新自行车。

ex.en: Mike, here is your book.
ex.zh: 迈克，这是你的书。

senses.en: A boy's name.

ex.en: Jack is my brother.
ex.zh: 杰克是我的哥哥。

ex.en: Jack is in Class One, Grade Seven.
ex.zh: 杰克在七年级一班。

senses.en: A girl's name.

ex.en: Mary is a good student.
ex.zh: 玛丽是个好学生。

ex.en: Mary likes English very much.
ex.zh: 玛丽非常喜欢英语。

senses.en: A family name; also a person who works in a flour mill.

ex.en: I'm Jim Miller.
ex.zh: 我是吉姆·米勒。

tip: 作姓氏时只表示家族名称。

senses.en: A girl's name.

ex.en: Linda is in my class.
ex.zh: 琳达和我同班。

ex.en: Linda has a nice schoolbag.
ex.zh: 琳达有一个漂亮的书包。

senses.en: A girl's name.

ex.en: Jane is my English teacher.
ex.zh: 简是我的英语老师。

ex.en: Jane Smith is from the US.
ex.zh: 简·史密斯来自美国。

senses.en: A common English family name.

ex.en: His last name is Smith.
ex.zh: 他姓史密斯。

ex.en: Mr Smith is our teacher.
ex.zh: 史密斯先生是我们的老师。

senses.en: a female sibling
a woman who belongs to a religious community

ex.en: My younger sister always borrows my favourite blue jumper.
ex.zh: 我妹妹总是借穿我最喜欢的蓝色毛衣。

ex.en: Children who regularly share responsibilities with a brother or sister may develop stronger cooperation skills at home.
ex.zh: 经常与兄弟姐妹分担责任的孩子，可能会在家中培养出更强的合作能力。

tip: sister不分姐姐妹妹；需用older或younger说明年龄关系。

senses.en: A female parent.
Care for someone protectively, as a mother would.

ex.en: My mother taught me how to ride a bicycle.
ex.zh: 我妈妈教会了我骑自行车。

ex.en: Affordable childcare can help a mother return to work without placing excessive pressure on the family budget.
ex.zh: 负担得起的托育服务能帮助母亲重返职场，而不给家庭预算带来过大压力。

tip: 英式口语常用mum，美式口语常用mom。

senses.en: A male parent.
A man who established or greatly influenced a field.
To become the biological father of a child.

ex.en: Her father taught her to ride a bicycle.
ex.zh: 她爸爸教她骑自行车。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can allow fathers to take a more active role in raising their children.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排可以让父亲更积极地参与养育子女。

col: the father of modern medicine｜现代医学之父
tip: father较正式，dad更口语化；父亲节用Father's Day。

senses.en: a person's mother or father
a company that owns or controls another company
to raise and care for a child as a parent

ex.en: Each parent brought a snack for the school picnic.
ex.zh: 每位家长都为学校野餐带了一份点心。

ex.en: Schools should involve parents in educational decisions because family support plays an important role in children's learning.
ex.zh: 学校应让家长参与教育决策，因为家庭支持在孩子的学习中发挥着重要作用。

tip: parent指父母中的一位；parents通常指父母双方。

senses.en: A male who has one or both parents in common with you.

ex.en: My younger brother borrowed my bicycle this morning.
ex.zh: 我弟弟今天早上借用了我的自行车。

ex.en: Older brothers and sisters can support younger children's learning by reading with them regularly at home.
ex.zh: 哥哥姐姐可以通过经常在家陪弟弟妹妹阅读来帮助他们学习。

tip: brother不区分兄弟；用older或younger说明长幼。

senses.en: The mother of your father or mother.

ex.en: My grandmother grows fresh herbs on her kitchen windowsill.
ex.zh: 我的祖母在厨房窗台上种新鲜的香草。

ex.en: For many working parents, a grandmother provides essential childcare and helps maintain strong family connections.
ex.zh: 对许多在职父母来说，祖母或外祖母提供了不可或缺的育儿帮助，也有助于维系紧密的家庭关系。

tip: 可指祖母或外祖母；口语常用grandma。

senses.en: The father of your mother or father.

ex.en: My grandfather taught me how to grow tomatoes.
ex.zh: 我的祖父教过我如何种番茄。

ex.en: A grandfather who provides regular childcare can strengthen family bonds and support working parents.
ex.zh: 经常帮忙照顾孩子的祖父或外祖父能够增进家庭感情，并为在职父母提供支持。

tip: 不区分父系母系；外祖父可说maternal grandfather。

senses.zh: 祖父母或外祖父母之一
senses.en: The father or mother of one of your parents.

ex.en: Each grandparent brought a homemade dish to our picnic.
ex.zh: 每位祖辈都带了一道自制的菜来参加我们的野餐。

ex.en: A grandparent can provide valuable emotional support when both parents work outside the home.
ex.zh: 当父母都在外工作时，祖父母或外祖父母可以提供宝贵的情感支持。

col: visit your grandparents｜探望祖父母或外祖父母
tip: 单数指一位祖辈；复数可指祖父母或外祖父母。

senses.en: a group of people related to one another
a group of related animals, plants, languages, or other things

ex.en: My family gathers around the kitchen table every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我的家人每周日都会围坐在厨房的餐桌旁。

ex.en: Flexible working hours can help parents balance family responsibilities with the demands of paid employment.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间可以帮助父母平衡家庭责任与有偿工作的要求。

tip: family作整体用单数；英式英语强调成员时可用复数。

senses.en: Plural of 'that'; things or people farther away.

ex.en: Who are those boys?
ex.zh: 那些男孩是谁？

ex.en: Those are my friends.
ex.zh: 那些是我的朋友。

tip: this 的复数是 these，that 的复数是 those。

senses.en: Asking about a person or people.

ex.en: Who is she? — She is my sister.
ex.zh: 她是谁？——她是我的姐姐。

ex.en: Who is that boy?
ex.zh: 那个男孩是谁？

senses.en: Expresses surprise, understanding, or other feelings.
senses.zh: 哦；哎呀（表示惊讶、领悟等）

ex.en: Oh, I see!
ex.zh: 哦，我明白了！

ex.en: Oh no! I'm late.
ex.zh: 哦不！我迟到了。

senses.en: Used before plural nouns for nearby people or things.
Nearby people or things, or ones just mentioned.

ex.en: These strawberries smell lovely, so let's buy a basket.
ex.zh: 这些草莓闻起来很香，我们买一篮吧。

ex.en: These findings suggest that regular outdoor activities can improve children's concentration and emotional health.
ex.zh: 这些研究结果表明，经常参加户外活动可以改善儿童的注意力和情绪健康。

col: in these circumstances｜在这些情况下
tip: these是this的复数，后接复数名词。

senses.en: Used for people or things already mentioned or understood.

senses.zh: 指性别未知或非二元者
senses.en: Used for someone of unknown or nonbinary gender.

ex.en: The children waved as they boarded the bus.
ex.zh: 孩子们一边上公交车一边挥手。

ex.en: When a student receives constructive feedback, they are more likely to identify weaknesses and improve their performance.
ex.zh: 学生收到建设性反馈后，更有可能发现不足并改善表现。

tip: 单数they也搭配are、have，不用is、has。

senses.en: In a good way; to a high standard.
Healthy; not ill.

ex.en: I feel well today.
ex.zh: 我今天感觉很好。

ex.en: He speaks English very well.
ex.zh: 他英语说得很好。

tip: well 作副词修饰动词；good 是形容词，修饰名词。

senses.en: To own or hold something.
To experience or take part in something.

ex.en: I have a sister and a brother.
ex.zh: 我有一个姐姐和一个弟弟。

ex.en: We have English class today.
ex.zh: 我们今天有英语课。

col: have a good day｜过得愉快
tip: 第三人称单数形式是 has，不是 haves。

senses.en: a period of twenty-four hours
the part of each day when there is natural light
a particular period in the past or present

ex.en: We spent the whole day building sandcastles on the beach.
ex.zh: 我们一整天都在海滩上堆沙堡。

ex.en: Shorter working days may improve employee wellbeing while allowing parents to spend more time with their children.
ex.zh: 缩短每日工作时间可能改善员工的身心状态，同时让家长有更多时间陪伴孩子。

tip: every day意为每天；everyday是形容词，意为日常的。

senses.en: A friendly way to say goodbye.
senses.zh: 祝你今天过得愉快（告别语）

ex.en: Have a good day, Mum!
ex.zh: 妈妈，祝你今天过得开心！

ex.en: Bye! Have a good day!
ex.zh: 再见！祝你一天愉快！

senses.en: A short, informal way to say goodbye.

ex.en: Bye, Tom! See you tomorrow.
ex.zh: 再见，汤姆！明天见。

ex.en: I must go now. Bye!
ex.zh: 我得走了。再见！

tip: bye 是 goodbye 的简短说法。

senses.en: A male child in relation to his parents.

ex.en: Their son helped them plant flowers in the garden.
ex.zh: 他们的儿子帮他们在花园里种花。

ex.en: Parents should give their sons and daughters equal opportunities to pursue education and develop practical skills.
ex.zh: 父母应给予儿子和女儿平等的机会，让他们接受教育并培养实用技能。

tip: son与sun同音；成年男性也仍是父母的son。

senses.zh: 堂兄弟姐妹；表兄弟姐妹
senses.en: A child of your aunt or uncle

ex.en: My cousin taught me to ride a bicycle yesterday.
ex.zh: 我的表姐昨天教我骑自行车。

ex.en: Children who regularly spend time with their cousins may develop strong family bonds beyond their immediate household.
ex.zh: 经常与堂表兄弟姐妹相处的孩子，可能与小家庭之外的亲人建立深厚感情。

col: a distant cousin｜远房堂亲或表亲
a younger cousin｜年幼的堂表亲
tip: 不区分堂表、性别或长幼；需要时另加说明。

senses.en: Your grandfather, informal.

ex.en: My grandpa is seventy years old.
ex.zh: 我的爷爷七十岁了。

ex.en: Grandpa reads newspapers every morning.
ex.zh: 爷爷每天早上看报纸。

tip: 书面语用 grandfather，日常口语用 grandpa。

senses.en: Your mother, informal (American English).

ex.en: My mom is a teacher.
ex.zh: 我的妈妈是老师。

ex.en: Mom, I'm home!
ex.zh: 妈妈，我回来了！

tip: 英式口语里常用 mum，美式常用 mom。

senses.en: Your parent's sister, or the wife of your parent's sibling.

ex.en: My aunt taught me how to bake bread.
ex.zh: 我姨妈教会了我如何烤面包。

ex.en: Extended family members, such as aunts and uncles, often provide valuable childcare support for working parents.
ex.zh: 姑姨叔舅等大家庭成员常为在职父母提供宝贵的育儿支持。

col: aunt and uncle｜姑姨叔舅等亲属
tip: 不区分父系或母系；美音也常读/ɑːnt/。

senses.en: Your grandmother, informal.

ex.en: My grandma makes nice food.
ex.zh: 我奶奶做的饭很好吃。

ex.en: Grandma is in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 奶奶在厨房里。

senses.en: Your father, informal.

ex.en: My dad works in a hospital.
ex.zh: 我爸爸在医院工作。

ex.en: Dad, this is my friend Eric.
ex.zh: 爸爸，这是我的朋友埃里克。

senses.en: a parent's brother or an aunt's husband

ex.en: My uncle taught me how to mend a bicycle.
ex.zh: 我叔叔教过我怎样修自行车。

ex.en: An uncle or aunt can provide valuable emotional support when parents are busy with work commitments.
ex.zh: 父母忙于工作时，叔伯姑姨等亲属可以提供宝贵的情感支持。

col: uncle and aunt｜叔伯姑姨等亲属
tip: uncle不区分父母哪一方，也不区分长幼。

senses.en: Someone's female child.

ex.en: Their daughter made pancakes for the whole family.
ex.zh: 他们的女儿给全家人做了薄煎饼。

ex.en: Equal access to education ensures that daughters and sons have similar opportunities to develop their talents.
ex.zh: 平等的受教育机会确保女儿和儿子都能有相近的机会发展自身才能。

col: a teenage daughter｜十几岁的女儿
a mother and daughter｜一对母女
tip: daughter-in-law是儿媳，不是继女。

senses.en: In or to this place.

ex.en: Here is a photo of my family.
ex.zh: 这是我的一张全家福。

ex.en: Your book is here.
ex.zh: 你的书在这里。

tip: Here is ... 用于出示或介绍某物。

senses.en: A picture made using a camera.

ex.en: We took a photo beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们在那座老桥旁拍了张照片。

ex.en: Historical photos provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
ex.zh: 历史照片为研究城市景观和日常生活方式如何随时间变化提供了宝贵证据。

tip: photo是photograph的常用简称；复数为photos。

senses.en: Belonging to; from; or about somebody or something.

ex.en: A photo of my family.
ex.zh: 我的一张全家福。

ex.en: The name of the school is on the wall.
ex.zh: 学校的名字在墙上。

tip: of 前面的名词常是「无生命事物」的所属，如 the door of the room。

senses.en: coming immediately after the present one
immediately after this; on the following occasion

ex.en: Our next bus leaves in about ten minutes.
ex.zh: 我们要坐的下一班公交车大约十分钟后发车。

ex.en: Over the next decade, governments will need to invest more heavily in affordable public transport.
ex.zh: 未来十年，各国政府需要加大对价格可负担的公共交通的投入。

tip: “下周”用next week，不加the；the next week指随后一周。

senses.en: an image made by drawing, painting, or taking a photograph
an idea or description of what a situation is like
to form an image of someone or something in your mind

ex.en: She hung a picture of the sea above her bed.
ex.zh: 她在床头上方挂了一幅海景画。

ex.en: Survey results provide a clearer picture of how housing costs affect the wellbeing of young adults.
ex.zh: 调查结果更清楚地呈现了住房成本如何影响年轻成年人的幸福感。

col: picture yourself doing something｜想象自己做某事
tip: take a picture是拍照；draw a picture是画画。

senses.en: A female child or young woman

ex.en: The girl carefully carried her kitten into the house.
ex.zh: 那个女孩小心翼翼地把小猫抱进屋里。

ex.en: Ensuring that every girl can attend school is essential for reducing inequality and supporting economic development.
ex.zh: 确保每个女孩都能上学，对于减少不平等和促进经济发展至关重要。

tip: 成年女性正式称woman；girl不直接表示女朋友。

senses.en: An animal often kept as a pet or trained for work.
To cause persistent problems for someone or something.

ex.en: Our dog waits by the door every afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们的狗每天下午都守在门边。

ex.en: Training a guide dog requires considerable time, but it can greatly improve someone's independence.
ex.zh: 训练一只导盲犬需要大量时间，但它能显著增强使用者的独立生活能力。

col: be dogged by problems｜长期受问题困扰
tip: 动词常见被动式be dogged by，表示长期受困扰。

senses.en: A girl's name.

ex.en: Sally is Kate's sister.
ex.zh: 萨莉是凯特的姐姐。

ex.en: Sally, is this your photo?
ex.zh: 萨莉，这是你的照片吗？

senses.en: A girl's name, short for Catherine.

ex.en: Kate is in Class One.
ex.zh: 凯特在一班。

ex.en: Kate has a nice family photo.
ex.zh: 凯特有一张好看的全家福。

senses.en: A boy's name.

ex.en: Paul is Sally's brother.
ex.zh: 保罗是萨莉的哥哥。

ex.en: Paul is a middle school student.
ex.zh: 保罗是一名中学生。

senses.en: A tool with a solid core for writing or drawing.
To write or draw something with a pencil.

ex.en: She sharpened her pencil before sketching the sleeping cat.
ex.zh: 她削好铅笔，开始画那只熟睡的猫。

ex.en: Using a pencil allows students to revise diagrams easily as their understanding of scientific concepts develops.
ex.zh: 使用铅笔让学生能随着对科学概念理解的加深，轻松修改图示。

tip: 用铅笔写说in pencil；pencil in指暂定安排。

senses.en: A set of pages joined together for reading
To arrange in advance to use a service or attend something

ex.en: I left my book on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我把书落在厨房的桌子上了。

ex.en: Public libraries provide free access to books, helping people continue learning regardless of their income.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆提供免费借阅书籍的机会，让不同收入的人都能持续学习。

tip: book 作动词表示预订，可直接接房间、机票等。

senses.en: A small object used to remove pencil marks.

ex.en: I borrowed an eraser to correct my pencil drawing.
ex.zh: 我借了一块橡皮擦来修改铅笔画。

ex.en: Providing basic classroom supplies, including pencils and erasers, helps ensure that all children can participate in lessons.
ex.zh: 提供铅笔和橡皮擦等基本课堂用品，有助于确保所有孩子都能参与课堂学习。

tip: eraser常用于美式英语；英式英语常说rubber。

senses.en: a container with firm sides, often with a lid
to put something into a box
to compete in a sport using punches and protective gloves

ex.en: The kitten fell asleep inside an empty cardboard box.
ex.zh: 小猫在一个空纸箱里睡着了。

ex.en: Retailers can reduce packaging waste by choosing a box that closely matches the size of each product.
ex.zh: 零售商可以选择与每件商品大小相近的箱子，以减少包装浪费。

col: a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力
tip: 复数为boxes；a box of后接盒中物品。

senses.en: A box for pencils, pens and other school things.

ex.en: My pens are in the pencil box.
ex.zh: 我的钢笔在铅笔盒里。

ex.en: His pencil box is blue.
ex.zh: 他的铅笔盒是蓝色的。

senses.en: A bag for carrying school books and things.

ex.en: My schoolbag is heavy today.
ex.zh: 我的书包今天很重。

ex.en: The schoolbag is under the desk.
ex.zh: 书包在课桌下面。

senses.en: a resource listing words with their meanings, pronunciations, or translations

ex.en: I checked the pronunciation of this word in a dictionary.
ex.zh: 我查了词典，确认这个词的发音。

ex.en: Using a bilingual dictionary can help language learners understand unfamiliar vocabulary without relying entirely on their teachers.
ex.zh: 使用双语词典能帮助语言学习者理解陌生词汇，而不必完全依赖教师。

tip: 查词用look up a word in a dictionary。

senses.en: Something that belongs to me.

ex.en: This book is mine.
ex.zh: 这本书是我的。

ex.en: The red schoolbag is mine.
ex.zh: 那个红色的书包是我的。

tip: mine 后面不能再接名词；my book = the book is mine。

senses.en: Something that belongs to her.

ex.en: The pen is hers.
ex.zh: 这支钢笔是她的。

ex.en: Is this schoolbag hers?
ex.zh: 这个书包是她的吗？

senses.en: a reason given to explain or defend a fault
forgive someone for a mistake or impolite behaviour
allow someone to avoid a duty or leave

ex.en: He made an excuse for arriving late to dinner.
ex.zh: 他为晚餐迟到找了个借口。

ex.en: Limited funding should not become an excuse for neglecting essential maintenance in schools and public hospitals.
ex.zh: 资金有限不应成为忽视学校和公立医院必要维护工作的借口。

col: excuse someone from｜准许某人免于
tip: 名词末尾读/s/，动词读/z/；excuse me常用于礼貌打断。

senses.en: The speaker, as object of a verb or preposition.

ex.en: Please give me the book.
ex.zh: 请把书给我。

ex.en: This is me in the photo.
ex.zh: 照片里的这个人是我。

tip: I 是主格作主语，me 是宾格作宾语。

senses.en: A polite way to get attention or say sorry.
senses.zh: 劳驾；打扰一下（礼貌用语）

ex.en: Excuse me, is this your pen?
ex.zh: 打扰一下，这是你的钢笔吗？

ex.en: Excuse me. Where is Class One?
ex.zh: 不好意思，一班在哪里？

tip: 提问或打扰别人前说 Excuse me，最常用。

senses.en: To tell somebody you are grateful.

ex.en: I want to thank my teacher.
ex.zh: 我想感谢我的老师。

ex.en: Thank you for your help.
ex.zh: 谢谢你的帮助。

tip: 日常口头道谢更常说 Thank you 或 Thanks。

senses.en: someone whose job is to help people learn

ex.en: Our teacher brought a plant into class today.
ex.zh: 我们的老师今天带了一株植物来上课。

ex.en: A well-trained teacher can adapt classroom activities to support students with different learning needs and abilities.
ex.zh: 训练有素的教师能够调整课堂活动，以帮助学习需求和能力各不相同的学生。

tip: 英语中称呼老师通常用Mr、Ms等加姓，不直接喊Teacher。

senses.en: concerning a particular subject
approximately, rather than exactly
in various places within or around somewhere

ex.en: We talked about our holiday plans over dinner.
ex.zh: 我们吃晚饭时聊了假期计划。

ex.en: Schools should teach children about the environmental consequences of their everyday choices and habits.
ex.zh: 学校应教导孩子了解日常选择和习惯对环境的影响。

tip: about可表示话题或约数；be about to表示即将。

senses.en: Used to ask for an opinion or a suggestion.

ex.en: What about this red one?
ex.zh: 这件红色的怎么样？

ex.en: I'm free on Sunday. What about you?
ex.zh: 我周日有空。你呢？

tip: What about + 名词/动名词：What about going home?

senses.en: Something that belongs to you.
senses.zh: 你的；你们的（名词性物主代词）

ex.en: Is this pen yours?
ex.zh: 这支钢笔是你的吗？

ex.en: The big classroom is yours.
ex.zh: 那间大教室是你们的。

senses.en: Intended for somebody; in favour of.
senses.zh: 给；为了（表示对象或目的）

senses.en: Because of.

ex.en: This book is for you.
ex.zh: 这本书是给你的。

ex.en: Thank you for helping me.
ex.zh: 谢谢你帮我。

tip: thank you for ... 表示「为……而感谢」。

senses.en: A polite phrase to thank someone for a thing.

ex.en: Thank you for your letter.
ex.zh: 谢谢你的来信。

ex.en: Thank you for the nice photo.
ex.zh: 谢谢你寄来这么好的照片。

tip: for 后接名词或动名词：Thank you for coming.

senses.en: Make something easier or better for someone.
Support that makes a difficulty or task easier.

ex.en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这些袋子提上楼吗？

ex.en: Affordable public transport can help residents access jobs and reduce their dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会，并减少他们对汽车的依赖。

col: help someone with something｜帮助某人做某事
tip: help后接动词原形或to不定式均可。

senses.en: to greet someone warmly or accept something with pleasure
wanted, appreciated, or gladly accepted
the way someone is greeted when they arrive

ex.en: Our neighbours came outside to welcome us home.
ex.zh: 邻居们走到外面，欢迎我们回家。

ex.en: Many communities welcome new cultural festivals because they encourage social interaction and support local businesses.
ex.zh: 许多社区欢迎新的文化节庆活动，因为这些活动能促进社交互动并支持当地商家。

col: a welcome change｜令人欣喜的变化
tip: be welcome to do表示可随意做；You're welcome用于回应感谢。

senses.en: A polite answer to 'thank you'.
senses.zh: 不客气；不用谢（回答道谢）

ex.en: Thank you! — You're welcome.
ex.zh: 谢谢你！——不客气。

ex.en: Thanks for your help. — You're welcome.
ex.zh: 谢谢你的帮助。——不用谢。

senses.en: A team sport involving hitting a ball and running between bases
The small, hard ball used in this sport

ex.en: We played baseball in the park after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，我们在公园打棒球。

ex.en: Team sports such as baseball can help young people develop cooperation skills and maintain physical fitness.
ex.zh: 棒球等团队运动能帮助年轻人培养合作能力并保持身体健康。

tip: 运动名称不可数；表示一个棒球时用a baseball。

senses.en: To look at something attentively for a period of time.
A small clock worn on the wrist or carried.
To take care of someone or look for possible danger.

ex.en: We watched the ducks swimming across the quiet pond.
ex.zh: 我们看着鸭子游过平静的池塘。

ex.en: Students who watch educational programmes may gain useful knowledge, but active discussion helps deepen their understanding.
ex.zh: 观看教育节目的学生可能获得实用知识，但积极讨论有助于加深理解。

tip: watch 强调持续观看；see 强调看见这一结果。

senses.en: An electronic machine that stores and processes information using programs.

ex.en: My computer froze while I was editing holiday photos.
ex.zh: 我编辑度假照片时，电脑卡住了。

ex.en: Access to a computer at home can help students complete assignments and develop essential digital skills.
ex.zh: 在家能使用电脑可以帮助学生完成作业，并培养必要的数字技能。

tip: 在电脑上工作用work on a computer。

senses.en: an activity or contest played according to rules
wild animals hunted for food or sport, or their meat
willing to try something difficult or unfamiliar

ex.en: We played a board game after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后我们玩了一个桌游。

ex.en: Cooperative games can help children develop communication skills and learn to solve problems together.
ex.zh: 合作型游戏能帮助儿童培养沟通能力，并学会共同解决问题。

tip: 猎物义不可数；be game for表示愿意尝试。

senses.en: A small stiff rectangle used for payment, identification, or information.
A decorated card sent with a greeting or personal message.
One of a set of small rectangles used in games.

ex.en: I tapped my card to pay for the groceries.
ex.zh: 我刷卡支付了买食品杂货的钱。

ex.en: Providing every student with a library card encourages independent reading and improves access to educational resources.
ex.zh: 为每位学生办理借书证，有助于鼓励自主阅读，并改善教育资源的获取条件。

tip: play cards指打牌，cards用复数，前面不加冠词。

senses.en: A card that shows who you are.

ex.en: This is my ID card.
ex.zh: 这是我的身份证。

ex.en: Can I see your ID card?
ex.zh: 我可以看看你的身份证吗？

tip: ID 是 identity（身份）的缩写。

senses.en: A book of blank pages for writing notes.
A small portable computer with a folding screen.

ex.en: She keeps a small notebook beside her bed.
ex.zh: 她在床边放着一本小笔记本。

ex.en: Keeping a notebook during fieldwork allows researchers to record observations that photographs alone may not capture.
ex.zh: 实地研究时使用笔记本，有助于研究人员记录仅靠照片可能无法捕捉的观察结果。

col: write in a notebook｜在笔记本上写
a spiral notebook｜螺旋装订笔记本
tip: 通常指纸质笔记本；电脑义也可说notebook computer。

senses.en: a circular band, especially one worn on a finger
to make a bell sound or cause one to sound
to contact someone by telephone

ex.en: She slipped the silver ring onto her finger.
ex.zh: 她把那枚银戒指戴在了手指上。

ex.en: Passengers should silence their phones because devices that ring repeatedly can disturb others on public transport.
ex.zh: 乘客应将手机调至静音，因为设备反复响铃会打扰公共交通工具上的其他人。

col: give someone a ring｜给某人打电话
tip: 响铃、打电话的过去式为rang，过去分词为rung。

senses.en: A container made from flexible material, used for carrying things.
To put something into a bag.

ex.en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
ex.zh: 她把苹果放进了一个可重复使用的袋子里。

ex.en: Charging customers for plastic bags can encourage shoppers to adopt more environmentally responsible habits.
ex.zh: 向顾客收取塑料袋费用，可以鼓励购物者养成更环保的习惯。

col: a reusable bag｜可重复使用的袋子
tip: a bag of后接所装物品，如a bag of rice。

senses.en: A place where people read or borrow books and other materials.
An organised collection of books, recordings, or digital resources.

ex.en: I borrowed three books from the library after school.
ex.zh: 放学后，我从图书馆借了三本书。

ex.en: Public libraries support lifelong learning by providing free access to books, digital resources, and quiet study spaces.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆通过免费提供书籍、数字资源和安静的学习空间来支持终身学习。

tip: library是借阅书籍的图书馆，bookshop是售书的书店。

senses.en: say something to get information or an answer
say that you want someone to do or give something
invite someone to come somewhere or join an activity

ex.en: I asked the driver where the bus stopped.
ex.zh: 我问司机公交车在哪里停。

ex.en: Schools should ask students for feedback before introducing major changes to classroom teaching methods.
ex.zh: 学校在对课堂教学方法作出重大调整前，应征求学生的反馈。

col: ask someone to do something｜请某人做某事
ask someone over｜邀请某人来家里
tip: ask for接想要的东西；ask someone to do表示请某人做。

senses.en: To request something from somebody.

ex.en: Can I ask you for help?
ex.zh: 我可以向你求助吗？

ex.en: Ask your teacher for the key.
ex.zh: 向老师要钥匙吧。

senses.en: To discover something or locate what you were looking for.
To have a particular opinion or experience of something.
Something useful or valuable that someone discovers.

ex.en: I finally found my keys inside my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 我终于在外套口袋里找到了钥匙。

ex.en: Many students find online courses convenient, although some struggle to stay motivated without classroom interaction.
ex.zh: 许多学生觉得网络课程很方便，但有些人在缺少课堂互动时难以保持学习动力。

col: find a solution｜找到解决办法
find it difficult to｜觉得做某事困难
a valuable find｜有价值的发现物
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为found；find＋宾语＋形容词。

senses.en: An unspecified amount or number of something.
An unspecified number or amount of people or things.
Approximately, used before an amount or number.

ex.en: I bought some fresh bread on my way home.
ex.zh: 我在回家的路上买了些新鲜面包。

ex.en: Some residents support the proposed cycle lanes, while others worry about losing parking spaces.
ex.zh: 一些居民支持拟建的自行车道，另一些人则担心停车位会减少。

tip: 可修饰复数名词或不可数名词；弱读常为/səm/。

senses.en: a room where students are taught

ex.en: Sunlight filled the classroom as we opened our books.
ex.zh: 我们打开书本时，阳光洒满了教室。

ex.en: A well-designed classroom should provide adequate lighting, comfortable furniture, and enough space for students to work together.
ex.zh: 设计良好的教室应有充足的照明、舒适的家具，以及供学生合作学习的足够空间。

tip: in the classroom强调教室内；in class强调上课中。

senses.zh: 电子邮件；电子邮件通信
senses.en: An electronic message, or the system used to send it
Send someone a message using email

ex.en: Please email me the photos from our camping trip.
ex.zh: 请把我们露营旅行的照片通过电子邮件发给我。

ex.en: Although email enables rapid communication, excessive messages can distract employees and reduce productivity at work.
ex.zh: 虽然电子邮件可以实现快速沟通，但过多的邮件会分散员工注意力，降低工作效率。

col: send an email｜发送电子邮件
check your email｜查看电子邮件
an email address｜电子邮箱地址
tip: 指一封邮件时可数；指通信方式时不可数，如by email。

senses.en: Showing a place or position.
Showing a time.

ex.en: I am at home now.
ex.zh: 我现在在家。

ex.en: We have lunch at school.
ex.zh: 我们在学校吃午饭。

tip: 大地点用 in（in Beijing），小地点和时间点常用 at（at home, at six）。

senses.en: To telephone someone or shout to get their attention.
To give someone or something a particular name.
A telephone conversation or a public request for action.

ex.en: I'll call you when I get home tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚到家后我会给你打电话。

ex.en: Environmental groups call for stricter regulations to reduce plastic waste entering rivers and oceans.
ex.zh: 环保团体呼吁制定更严格的法规，减少流入河流和海洋的塑料垃圾。

col: call for action｜呼吁采取行动
call someone back｜给某人回电话
tip: call sb表示给某人打电话，不加to。

senses.en: Unable to find the way, or unable to be found.
Unable to understand something or decide what to do.
Past tense and past participle of lose.

ex.en: We got lost while walking through the old town.
ex.zh: 我们在老城区步行时迷路了。

ex.en: Without clear guidance, new university students may feel lost when choosing courses that affect their future careers.
ex.zh: 缺少明确指导时，大学新生在选择影响未来职业的课程时可能会感到迷茫。

tip: get lost可指迷路；单独用作命令语气粗鲁。

senses.en: used to express a strong obligation or requirement
used to express a confident conclusion
something considered essential

ex.en: You must wear a helmet when riding here.
ex.zh: 在这里骑车必须戴头盔。

ex.en: Governments must ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 政府必须确保所有儿童都能接受优质教育，不论其家庭收入如何。

col: must have done｜想必已经做过
an absolute must｜绝对必需的事物
tip: must是情态动词；mustn't表禁止，不是“不必”。

senses.en: Put something somewhere, or establish a condition, value, or rule.
A group of related things that belong together.
Fixed or arranged in advance.

ex.en: She set the bowl gently on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 她把碗轻轻放在厨房的桌子上。

ex.en: Governments should set clear targets for reducing air pollution and regularly assess progress towards achieving them.
ex.zh: 政府应设定明确的空气污染减排目标，并定期评估实现这些目标的进展。

col: a set of tools｜一套工具
tip: 过去式、过去分词均为set；现在分词为setting。
